title: fix_signal.skill.md Phase 3 uses patch_file as default contrary to deprecate-patch-file spec
description: Phase 3 of fix_signal.skill.md instructs the agent to call patch_file first for signal pickup markup, falling back to write_file only on error. The deprecate-patch-file spec (moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path) promoted write_file as the unconditional default for all modifications in skill files. In this run, patch_file failed (old_string not found — likely CRLF mismatch on Windows) and the write_file fallback was required, consuming an extra tool call.
proposed_resolution: Update fix_signal.skill.md Phase 3 signal-pickup instructions to call write_file directly without attempting patch_file first, mirroring the intent of the deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path spec.
